name: ArtCraft Studio
description: One desktop workspace for ten Rust creative apps: photo, vector, video, writing, decks, layout, effects, RAW, spreadsheets and PDF. This Agent Card is published for discovery only: the suite does not accept remote A2A tasks yet. Local agent integration is available through the bundled MCP server and the on-disk notification log.
